_note: Edit prizes/status here, then the daily workflow (or python3 build/build.py) republishes contests.html.

contests.name: 30-Day Learning Streak Challenge
contests.about: Learn something every day for 30 days on any Express Line. Keep your Daily Quiz streak alive and log what you studied.
contests.how: Share a screenshot of your 30-day streak plus a short learning log (doc or post link).
prizes: All finishers: featured on the Streak Wall
contests.judging: Completeness of the streak (40%), quality of the learning log (40%), progress shown (20%).

contests.name: Explain-It-Simply Video Contest
contests.about: Use the Feynman technique: explain one concept from any Express Line in a video under 3 minutes.
contests.how: Upload to YouTube (public or unlisted) and submit the link.
prizes: Winner: $150 + featured on our Video Express page

contests.name: Mini-Project Showcase
contests.about: Build a small project from any station — a website, analysis, budget model, campaign or lesson plan.
contests.how: Submit a link to your project and a 150-word write-up of what you learned.
prizes: Top 10: portfolio feature + certificate of recognition
